name: application-hover-card
title: Hover Card
description: Sighted-pointer preview cards that reveal rich context — a profile, a link preview — when a user hovers a trigger, without requiring a click.
useWhen: Sighted-pointer preview cards that reveal rich context — a profile, a link preview — when a user hovers a trigger, without requiring a click.
avoidWhen: Avoid hover card when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Hover Card uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
